question: How many personnel were awarded Gallantry and Service Medals on the occasion of Independence Day 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**1090**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• 1090 Personnel Awarded Gallantry and Service Medals on Independence Day 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
A total of **1090 personnel** from **Police, Fire, Home Guard, Civil Defence, and Correctional Services** have been awarded **Gallantry and Service Medals** on the occasion of **Independence Day 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
**233 personnel** have been awarded the **Medal for Gallantry**.

 
 
• 
 
**99 personnel** have received the **President’s Medal for Distinguished Service**.

 
 
• 
 
**758 personnel** have been awarded the **Medal for Meritorious Service**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Border Security Force (BSF)** announced that **sixteen Brave Seema Praharis** will receive **Gallantry Medals** for their **bravery and valour** during **Operation Sindoor**.
